aboutSection.paragraph1: Founded in 2025 in Nashik, Maharashtra, Yajurved Construction helps housing societies and landowners redevelop and build, and handles the paperwork that comes with it.
aboutSection.paragraph2_intro: We bring these services together under one roof:

listItems.item2: Property title verification, documentation and MahaRERA approvals

aboutSection.paragraph3: We are a young company, so we earn trust the slow way: clear process, written timelines and no claims we cannot show you.

cards.title: Construction & Society Redevelopment
cards.description: From feasibility and member consent to NMC approvals, demolition, construction and handover of new flats.

cards.title: Title Verification & Documentation
cards.description: 30-year title search, 7/12 extract and mutation checks, encumbrance search and registration of every document.

cards.title: MahaRERA Registration
cards.description: Eligibility check, full document set, project bank account, and quarterly progress reports after registration.

cards.title: Property Litigation Consultancy
cards.description: Document review, plain-language options and coordination with property advocates for title, partition and builder disputes.

cards.title: Financial Consultancy
cards.description: Feasibility models, self-redevelopment loans, corpus and rent planning, and GST and income tax planning with CAs.
